title: Whither Bias Goes, I Will Go: An Integrative, Systematic Review of Algorithmic Bias Mitigation

bias_targets.target: Algorithmic bias (including Racial and Gender bias)
bias_targets.methodology: Systematic literature review (following PRISMA guidelines) evaluating and categorizing fairness operationalizations, legal requirements (e.g., Civil Rights Act), and bias mitigation methods (preprocessing, inprocessing, postprocessing) across the machine learning development lifecycle for personnel selection.

Conceptual review and integration mapping computer science fairness metrics (e.g., equal accuracy, demographic parity) against traditional industrial-organizational psychology definitions of measurement and predictive bias.
